summary: Hindi uses होना as a broad copular verb, but many state/experiential meanings use other constructions; location and existence commonly use forms of होना with postpositional predicates.

semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: adjective/state predicate + होना; many experiential states instead use लगना or other constructions
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: result/state predicate + होना or lexical change/result construction
semantic_map.SEM.EVENT_LOCATION: event-specific होना-based or lexical event predicate
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: के पास … होना is a core locative/existential-style possession construction
